description:
Penguin × Exit 8 : A unique combination
Escape from the endlessly looping hallway.
If you find an anomaly, choose YES PEN.
If there is no anomaly, choose NO PEN.
All anomalies contain penguin elements.
Answer correctly 8 times in a row to escape.
A mixture of cuteness and fear.

※Pressing "Continue" allows you to collect undiscovered anomalies.

Penguin Hotel
This game is a spin-off of the mascot horror series "Penguin Hotel."
You don’t need to have played "Penguin Hotel" to enjoy it.
If you’re interested, give it a try!
About video production and distribution
Please include the name of this game in the distribution and video title.
Please put a link to SETAM in the summary section.
Other than the above, we do not specify anything else. Please use common sense.
We want many people to know this game. So videos and distribution are welcome.
